<!--
Global Ecosystem Classification 
-->


```{r typology_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Empty when typology wasn't requested (single consolidated "not requested"
# message lives in report_main.Rmd, and the parent suppresses the section
# header in that case too).

ecosystem_label <- if (is.na(params$ecosystem_name) || !nzchar(params$ecosystem_name)) {
  "ecosystem"
} else {
  params$ecosystem_name
}


if (is.null(params$typology)) {
  get_text <- ""
} else {
  get_text <- paste0(
    "To help the assessor identify the best match for the **", ecosystem_label, "** within the [IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (GET)](https://global-ecosystems.org/), the most recent classification map (**", max(params$years), "**)  was overlayed on the global GET maps and the percentage cover of each ecosystem functional group (EFG), including both major and minor occurrences was calculated.  A summary of EFGs within the mapped ecosystem is presented in the table below with **'", params$typology[1,3], "'** the most prevalent major EFG. Any EFG with <1% occurrence coverage in the ecosystem is not displayed in this table.")
}
```

`r get_text`


```{r typology_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$typology)}

    set_header_labels(EFG_CODE = "EFG code")
```
